response: Introducing Saved Views, available today on all paid plans. If you find yourself rebuilding the same filters and sort orders every time you open a project, this feature is for you. Now you can set up exactly the view you need — filtered by assignee, sorted by due date, grouped by status, whatever works for your workflow — and save it for one-click access later. Each user can save up to 50 views, so there's plenty of room for every project, client, or sprint you track. Views aren't locked to just you, either: share any saved view with your team so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating it themselves. This makes onboarding new teammates faster, keeps reporting consistent across the team, and cuts down on repetitive setup work. Saved Views is rolling out now to every paid workspace, with no extra configuration required. We think this small change will save real time in your day-to-day. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
